column1: # Board row status -> Hermes card native state: the one declaration of the mirror's forward map.
# Read by lib/board/board-mirror.sh (`_target_native`) and lib/board/board-mirror-cleanup.py (the state-drift check).
# Beside lib/board/states.tsv, which owns the row states; tests/test-board-states.sh fails when a state here is
# undeclared there or when either reader hardcodes the map again.
#   native  the Hermes kanban state a card for that row is created in. The set reachable from the CLI is
#           triage, ready, blocked (see the header of board-mirror.sh: todo and running have no durable path).
# A row state with no line here (shipped, dropped, or an unrecognized word) is not mirrored: no card is created
# for it, and an existing card is archived.
# Many-to-one on purpose: four states collapse to ready, so a card move cannot be reversed from this table;
# board-writeback.sh keeps the reverse map by hand.
